description: This source file defines a public enumeration 'BonjourServiceResolverSupport' that provides static utility methods for handling NetService resolution and hostname normalization, primarily used in Bonjour service discovery.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts resolving the given NetService with a specified timeout, scheduling it on the main run loop in common modes.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Normalizes a raw hostname string by trimming whitespace and removing a trailing dot if present.
